Empties the list of posts you've seen, so they can show up again.
column2: 본 게시물 목록을 비워서 다시 표시될 수 있게 해요.

column1: # context: toast after tapping that row
Seen posts forgotten.
# context: what a settings import changes; %1$s is a time such as 7 days
Posts you've seen will stay hidden for %1$s.
# context: settings row under Pause, backup and diagnostics that opens Facebook's own Whitehat screen; Whitehat is Facebook's name for its security researcher program, keep it
Facebook's Whitehat settings
# context: summary of that row when Facebook's screen is on the phone

Facebook's own screen for security testing. It can make Facebook trust security certificates you installed, or send its data through a proxy (a go-between server). Hushfacebook doesn't change anything there.
column2: Facebook 자체 보안 테스트 화면이에요. 설치한 보안 인증서를 Facebook이 신뢰하게 하거나, 데이터를 프록시(중계 서버)를 통해 보내게 할 수 있어요. Hushfacebook은 그곳의 설정을 바꾸지 않아요.

column1: # context: summary of that row when Facebook hasn't downloaded the screen, so the row opens a web page
Facebook hasn't downloaded this screen to this phone, so a tap opens the Whitehat page on the web instead.
column2: Facebook이 이 휴대폰에 이 화면을 다운로드하지 않아서, 탭하면 대신 웹의 Whitehat 페이지가 열려요.

column1: # context: toast when the Facebook version has no such screen

column2: 이 Facebook 빌드에는 Whitehat 설정 화면이 없어요.

column1: Only the first reel waits
With the switch above on, after you play one reel, the reels you swipe to play on their own. The feed and Watch always wait.
column2: 위 스위치가 켜져 있으면 릴스 하나를 재생한 후 스와이프해서 넘긴 릴스는 자동으로 재생돼요. 피드와 Watch는 항상 탭할 때까지 기다려요.

column1: Slower speeds
Adds 0.1x and 0.25x to the speed menu of reels and of feed and Watch videos, for slowing down a fast moment.
column2: 빠른 장면을 천천히 볼 수 있도록 릴스와 피드 및 Watch 동영상의 속도 메뉴에 0.1x와 0.25x를 추가해요.

column1: Faster speeds
Adds 2.5x and 3x to the speed menu of reels and of feed and Watch videos, for watching faster.
column2: 더 빠르게 볼 수 있도록 릴스와 피드 및 Watch 동영상의 속도 메뉴에 2.5x와 3x를 추가해요.

column1: Speed on finished live videos
A live video that has ended gets Playback speed in its gear menu, like other videos. Videos that are still live, and ads, keep Facebook's menu.
column2: 종료된 라이브 방송의 톱니바퀴 메뉴에 다른 동영상처럼 재생 속도가 추가돼요. 아직 라이브 중인 동영상과 광고는 Facebook의 메뉴를 그대로 유지해요.

Support Hushfacebook

Where ads and tracking are blocked

The places Facebook shows ads or reports what you do, and what this build does about each. A line with a switch takes you to it.

Hide group buttons in the share sheet

Takes away Send to group when you pick two or more people, and the share sheet's own ways to start a new group, so nothing you share makes a group chat by accident. Send separately stays.

Share the post's own link

Hide comments with shop links

Hide comments with your words

Line %1$d can't be saved. Check its length or use the profile or Page ID, then save again.
column2: %1$d번째 줄을 저장할 수 없어요. 길이를 확인하거나 프로필 또는 페이지 ID를 사용한 다음 다시 저장하세요.

column1: No file chosen. Choose a .ttf or .otf font file of up to %1$d MB.
column2: 선택한 파일이 없어요. 최대 %1$dMB의 .ttf 또는 .otf 글꼴 파일을 선택하세요.

column1: Removes the saved font file. Restart Facebook to use your phone's font.
column2: 저장된 글꼴 파일을 삭제해요. 휴대폰 글꼴을 사용하려면 Facebook을 다시 시작하세요.

column1: Removes the saved font file. Use the system font stays off.
column2: 저장된 글꼴 파일을 삭제해요. "시스템 글꼴 사용"은 꺼진 상태로 유지돼요.

column1: Saving diagnostic report...
Selected %1$s. Font changes apply after restarting Facebook.
column2: %1$s 파일을 선택했어요. 글꼴 변경 사항은 Facebook을 다시 시작한 후 적용돼요.

column1: Selected %1$s. Restart Facebook to apply the font change.
column2: %1$s 파일을 선택했어요. 글꼴 변경 사항을 적용하려면 Facebook을 다시 시작하세요.

column1: Selected %1$s. Turn on Use the system font and restart Facebook to use it.
column2: %1$s 파일을 선택했어요. 사용하려면 "시스템 글꼴 사용"을 켜고 Facebook을 다시 시작하세요.

column1: Selected %1$s. Use the system font is off. Turn it on and restart Facebook to use this file.
column2: %1$s 파일을 선택했어요. "시스템 글꼴 사용"이 꺼져 있어요. 이 파일을 사용하려면 켜고 Facebook을 다시 시작하세요.

column1: The diagnostic report couldn't be copied. Try again.
column2: 진단 보고서를 복사하지 못했어요. 다시 시도하세요.

column1: The list holds up to %1$d people, Pages or sites. Remove some, then save again.
column2: 목록에는 사람, 페이지, 사이트를 최대 %1$d개까지 넣을 수 있어요. 일부를 삭제한 다음 다시 저장하세요.

column1: The photo wasn't saved. Try again.
The report couldn't be copied. Try again.
The report couldn't be saved. Try again.
The saved copy of %1$s is missing. Choose the file again.
column2: 저장된 %1$s 사본이 없어요. 파일을 다시 선택하세요.

column1: The video wasn't saved. Try again.
This list needs more room than it has. Shorten it, then save again.
column2: 이 목록에 필요한 공간이 부족해요. 목록을 줄인 다음 다시 저장하세요.

column1: Your settings already match that file, so nothing will change.
column2: 설정이 이미 파일과 같아서 바뀌는 것이 없어요.

column1: # context: title of the row that restarts Facebook, shown while one change waits for a restart
Restart Facebook to apply this change
column2: 이 변경 사항을 적용하려면 Facebook 다시 시작

column1: # context: the same row with two or more changes waiting
Restart Facebook to apply %1$d changes
column2: 변경 사항 %1$d개를 적용하려면 Facebook 다시 시작

column1: # context: summary of that row; after the restart the settings screen opens again on the same page
Facebook closes and reopens on this page.
column2: Facebook이 종료된 후 이 페이지에서 다시 열려요.

column1: # context: title of the row just above Support at the end of the settings home page; a tap restarts Facebook at any time
Restart Facebook
# context: row near the end of the settings home page; opens a new bug report on GitHub
Report a problem
Opens a GitHub report with your versions and settings filled in. Add what happened.
column2: 버전과 설정이 미리 채워진 GitHub 신고를 엽니다. 무슨 일이 있었는지 적어 주세요.

column1: # context: row near the top of the settings home page; a list of ready-made sets of switches
Quick setups
# context: toast after a long press hides the Quick setups row from the settings home page; the page name is the one holding the row that brings it back
# context: row on the Pause, backup and diagnostics page; shows or hides the Quick setups row on the settings home page
# context: name of a Quick setups choice that hides ads and nags; an adjective, as in a quiet feed
Quiet
Hides ads, suggestions, promos and prompts, and stops nagging notifications.
column2: 광고, 추천, 홍보, 안내를 숨기고 성가신 알림을 멈춰요.

column1: # context: what the Privacy choice of Quick setups turns on; camera roll scans are Hold back camera roll processing
Holds back usage reports and camera roll scans, removes link tracking, and hides your typing and screenshots.
column2: 사용 보고와 카메라 롤 스캔을 보류하고, 링크 추적을 제거하며, 입력 중 표시와 스크린샷 감지를 숨겨요.

column1: # context: name of the Quick setups choice that puts the switches back as they were after install
Back to defaults
# context: Lock Facebook is the name of the app lock switch, left as it is
Puts every feature switch but Lock Facebook back the way it started.
column2: Facebook 잠금을 제외한 모든 기능 스위치를 처음 상태로 되돌려요.

column1: # context: toast after a Quick setups choice changed one switch
Changed %1$d setting
# context: the same toast for none, or for two or more
Changed %1$d settings
# context: toast and Last save row: a save failed for want of a connection
The connection failed. Check your internet and try again.
column2: 연결하지 못했어요. 인터넷 연결을 확인하고 다시 시도하세요.

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: the server answered a save with an error, not the file
Facebook's server didn't send the file. Try again in a moment.
column2: Facebook 서버가 파일을 보내지 않았어요. 잠시 후 다시 시도하세요.

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: the file a save fetched came empty or cut short
The download ended before the whole file arrived. Try again.
column2: 파일을 모두 받기 전에 다운로드가 끝났어요. 다시 시도하세요.

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: a save's work file couldn't be written, for a reason the phone didn't give
Your phone couldn't write the file. Check your free space and try again.
column2: 휴대폰에서 파일을 쓰지 못했어요. 여유 공간을 확인하고 다시 시도하세요.

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: the phone was measured and has too little free space for a save
Not enough free space to save this. Free some up and try again.
column2: 저장할 여유 공간이 부족해요. 공간을 확보한 다음 다시 시도하세요.

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: a video's picture and sound couldn't be converted or joined; Download quality is the setting's name
Your phone couldn't put this video together. Try another Download quality.
column2: 휴대폰에서 이 동영상을 합치지 못했어요. 다른 다운로드 화질을 선택해 보세요.

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: the gallery refused a finished photo or video
The file couldn't be copied into your phone's gallery. Try again in a moment.
column2: 파일을 휴대폰 갤러리에 복사하지 못했어요. 잠시 후 다시 시도하세요.

column1: # context: title of a switch on the Menu settings page: whether the Hushfacebook settings shortcut shows when you hold Facebook's launcher icon
Settings shortcut on the app icon
# context: title of a switch on the Menu settings page: whether a long press on the Facebook logo opens the Hushfacebook settings
Open settings from the logo
# context: title of a switch on the Menu settings page: whether the Hushfacebook settings row shows at the end of Settings and privacy in Facebook's Menu
Settings row in Menu
# context: summary of the switch for the Hushfacebook settings shortcut in the launcher icon's menu
Puts Hushfacebook settings in the menu you get by holding Facebook's icon. Off, it leaves that menu.
column2: Facebook 아이콘을 길게 눌렀을 때 나오는 메뉴에 Hushfacebook 설정을 넣어요. 끄면 그 메뉴에서 사라져요.

column1: # context: summary of the switch for opening the settings with a long press on the Facebook logo
A long press on the Facebook logo at the top of the home feed, or on the title at the top of another tab, opens these settings. Off, the long press goes back to Facebook.
column2: 홈 피드 상단의 Facebook 로고나 다른 탭 상단의 제목을 길게 누르면 이 설정이 열려요. 끄면 길게 누르기가 Facebook의 원래 동작으로 돌아가요.

column1: # context: summary of the switch for the Hushfacebook settings row in Facebook's Menu
Adds a Hushfacebook settings row at the end of Settings and privacy in Facebook's Menu. Off, the row leaves the Menu.
column2: Facebook 메뉴의 설정 및 개인정보 끝에 Hushfacebook 설정 항목을 추가해요. 끄면 메뉴에서 항목이 사라져요.

column1: # context: summary shown instead of a switch's usual one while it is the only one of the three ways into the settings still on, so it is greyed out
The last way into these settings stays on.
column2: 이 설정으로 들어오는 마지막 방법은 켜진 상태로 유지됩니다.

column1: # context: switch title on the Appearance settings page: hides Facebook Flex's Data mode bar under the top bar; Data mode is Facebook's own name for paid mode on Flex carriers
Hide the Data mode banner
# context: switch title on the Appearance settings page: hides Facebook Flex's purple Free mode bar; Free mode is Facebook's own name for the free text-only mode
Hide the Free mode banner
# context: summary of the Hide the Data mode banner switch
On carriers with Facebook Flex, hides the Data mode bar under the top bar and its button to buy mobile data.
column2: Facebook Flex를 지원하는 통신사에서 상단 바 아래의 데이터 모드 바와 모바일 데이터 구매 버튼을 숨겨요.

column1: # context: summary of the Hide the Free mode banner switch; the purple bar is also where you switch back to Data mode
On carriers with Facebook Flex, hides the purple Free mode bar. That bar is also how you go back to Data mode, so turn this off when you want to switch.
column2: Facebook Flex를 지원하는 통신사에서 보라색 무료 모드 바를 숨겨요. 이 바로 데이터 모드로 돌아갈 수도 있으므로, 전환하려면 이 스위치를 끄세요.

column1: # context: switch title under Picture-in-picture on the Playback page: the small window opens only from the Picture-in-picture row this adds to a reel's three-dot More menu, not when you leave Facebook
Only from a reel's More menu
# context: summary of that switch; Picture-in-picture is the name of the row in the reel's menu, translated as the row is; the three dots are the reel's own menu button
Leaving Facebook doesn't open the window. Tap Picture-in-picture in a reel's More menu (the three dots) when you want one.
column2: Facebook을 나가도 작은 창이 열리지 않아요. 원할 때 릴스의 더보기 메뉴(점 3개)에서 "PIP 모드"를 탭하세요.

column1: # context: switch title under Picture-in-picture on the Playback page; the button floats over a reel or video and opens the small window when tapped
Picture-in-picture button
# context: summary of that switch; "the window" is the small picture-in-picture window
Shows a small button at the left edge of a reel or video that has the window ready. Tap it to open the window right away. Works with Picture-in-picture on.
column2: 작은 창을 열 수 있는 릴스나 동영상의 왼쪽 가장자리에 작은 버튼을 표시해요. 탭하면 바로 작은 창이 열려요. "PIP 모드"가 켜져 있을 때 작동해요.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; on, a video you started keeps its sound after you leave Facebook; also the label of a headphones button in the picture-in-picture window
Keep playing in the background
Next reel in the background
When a reel playing in the background ends, the next reel plays instead of the same one again, and Reels keeps loading more as it goes. Works with Keep playing in the background on.
column2: 백그라운드에서 재생 중인 릴스가 끝나면 같은 릴스를 반복하지 않고 다음 릴스를 재생하고, 릴스가 계속 더 불러와요. "백그라운드에서 계속 재생"이 켜져 있을 때 작동해요.

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the notification is the one Facebook shows with the video's play and pause buttons
A video you started with a tap, or a reel you swiped to in Reels, keeps its sound after you leave Facebook, and its notification can pause it. Swiping the notification away or taking a call stops it.
column2: 탭해서 시작한 동영상이나 릴스에서 스와이프해서 넘긴 릴스는 Facebook을 나간 후에도 소리가 계속 나고, 알림에서 일시 정지할 수 있어요. 알림을 밀어서 없애거나 전화를 받으면 멈춰요.

column1: # context: title of that notification when the video has none of its own
Facebook video
# context: switch title under Playback; on, the small picture-in-picture window gets a headphones button that keeps the sound playing after the window closes
Background play button in the window
# context: summary of that switch; "the window" is the small picture-in-picture window
Adds a headphones button to the picture-in-picture window. Tap it to close the window and keep the sound playing, with a notification to pause it.
column2: PIP 창에 헤드폰 버튼을 추가해요. 탭하면 창이 닫히고 소리는 계속 재생되며, 알림에서 일시 정지할 수 있어요.

column1: # context: switch title under Stories; it makes videos you post to your own Story ask for high quality when they upload
Upload Stories in HD
# context: summary of that switch; standard is the normal upload quality, high the better one
Videos you post to your Story ask Facebook for its high upload quality instead of standard. Applies to the next Story you post.
column2: 내 스토리에 올리는 동영상을 표준 대신 고화질로 업로드하도록 Facebook에 요청해요. 다음에 올리는 스토리부터 적용돼요.

column1: # context: switch title under Stories; a photo story is a still picture posted to your own Story, and a song added to it plays while the picture shows
Longer music on photo stories
# context: summary of that switch; 15 seconds is how long Facebook lets the song on a photo play, and the song's length can be shorter than 30
A song you add to a photo for your Story plays for up to 30 seconds instead of 15. Applies to the next song you pick.
column2: 스토리용 사진에 추가한 노래가 15초 대신 최대 30초 동안 재생돼요. 다음에 고르는 노래부터 적용돼요.

column1: # context: switch title under Stories; two fingers spread apart on a story or a profile photo make it bigger
Pinch to zoom
# context: summary of that switch; "let go" means lifting your fingers off the screen; "Photo carousel" is the label of another switch, so use its translation
Pinch a story, a video in your feed, or a photo on someone's profile or in Photo carousel to zoom in. It goes back when you let go.
column2: 스토리, 피드 동영상, 프로필 사진이나 사진 슬라이드의 사진을 두 손가락으로 벌려 확대하세요. 손을 떼면 원래대로 돌아가요.

column1: # context: switch title under Stories, right below Pinch to zoom; the zoomed picture stays zoomed after the fingers lift
Stay zoomed
# context: summary of that switch; "Pinch to zoom" is the label of the switch above it, so use its translation; "Back" is the phone's Back button
With Pinch to zoom on, the photo or story stays zoomed when you let go, and a story stays paused. Drag with one finger or pinch again. Tap or press Back when you're done.
column2: 두 손가락으로 확대가 켜져 있으면 손을 떼도 사진이나 스토리가 확대된 상태로 유지되고, 스토리는 일시 정지된 상태로 남아요. 한 손가락으로 드래그하거나 다시 두 손가락으로 조절하세요. 다 보면 탭하거나 뒤로 버튼을 누르세요.

column1: # context: switch title under Stories, right below Stay zoomed; two quick taps on a photo zoom it in where you tapped
Double tap to zoom
# context: summary of that switch; "Pinch to zoom" is the label of the switch two rows above it, so use its translation; a story is the full-screen picture or video someone shares for a day
With Pinch to zoom on, double tap a photo on a profile to zoom in where you tapped, and double tap again to put it back. A single tap still opens the photo, a moment later.
column2: 두 손가락으로 확대가 켜져 있으면 프로필의 사진을 두 번 탭해서 탭한 곳을 확대하고, 다시 두 번 탭하면 원래대로 돌아가요. 한 번 탭하면 잠시 후 여전히 사진이 열려요.

column1: # context: a switch under Pinch to zoom; with it on, the rest of the screen gets darker behind a zoomed photo or story
Dim around a zoom
# context: that switch's summary; "Pinch to zoom" is the label of the switch above it, so use its translation; a story is the full-screen picture or video someone shares for a day
With Pinch to zoom on, the screen around a photo or story darkens as you zoom in. Turn it off to keep the rest of the screen as it is.
column2: 두 손가락으로 확대가 켜져 있으면 확대할 때 사진이나 스토리 주변 화면이 어두워져요. 나머지 화면을 그대로 두려면 끄세요.

column1: # context: a switch under Pinch to zoom; with it on, a video you zoom keeps moving instead of freezing on the frame it showed
Keep videos playing while zoomed

# context: that switch's summary; "Pinch to zoom" and "Stay zoomed" are the labels of switches above it, so use their translations; a story is the full-screen picture or video someone shares for a day; "hold it first" means pressing and holding one finger on the story before the second finger comes down

With Pinch to zoom on, a video you zoom keeps playing, stories included. To zoom a story on a still frame, hold it first and then pinch. With Stay zoomed on too, press and hold the zoom to pause the video, and again to play it.
column2: 두 손가락으로 확대가 켜져 있으면 스토리를 포함해 확대한 동영상이 계속 재생돼요. 멈춘 장면에서 스토리를 확대하려면 먼저 길게 누른 다음 두 손가락으로 벌리세요. "확대 상태 유지"도 켜져 있으면 확대한 화면을 길게 눌러 동영상을 일시 정지하고, 다시 길게 눌러 재생하세요.

column1: No ads downloaded in advance
No ad tracking
No Facebook ads in other apps
Facebook ads in other apps
Part of the Reels ad blocking
Start-up fix for x86 phones
Version number Google Play sees
Hushfacebook in the Menu
Set when you patched, so Pause can't turn it off:\n%1$s\nTo rule it out, patch again and leave out its patch.
column2: 패치할 때 적용되어 일시 정지로 끌 수 없어요:\n%1$s\n이 기능이 원인인지 확인하려면 해당 패치를 빼고 다시 패치하세요.

column1: Set when you patched, so Pause can't turn these off:\n%1$s\nTo rule one out, patch again and leave out its patch.
column2: 패치할 때 적용되어 일시 정지로 끌 수 없어요:\n%1$s\n이 중 하나가 원인인지 확인하려면 해당 패치를 빼고 다시 패치하세요.

column1: For when Marketplace only or Events only is on. Neither is on now.
column2: 마켓플레이스만 또는 "이벤트만"이 켜져 있을 때 적용돼요. 지금은 둘 다 꺼져 있어요.

column1: Hide the Meta AI shortcut
The Meta AI shortcut leaves the Menu's list with Feeds, Marketplace, Reels and Groups, and the next shortcut moves up into its place.
column2: 피드, 마켓플레이스, 릴스, 그룹이 있는 메뉴 목록에서 Meta AI 바로가기가 사라지고, 다음 바로가기가 그 자리로 올라와요.

column1: Hide people to send to in the share sheet
Takes the row of profile pictures off the share sheet, the people Facebook suggests sending a post to. The search box and the other ways to share stay.
column2: Facebook이 게시물을 보내라고 추천하는 사람들의 프로필 사진 줄을 공유 화면에서 없애요. 검색창과 다른 공유 방법은 그대로 남아요.

column1: Hide who is typing in comments
Takes away the line that says someone is typing a comment. Your own typing is a separate switch under Privacy.
column2: 누군가 댓글을 입력 중이라는 줄을 없애요. 내 입력 중 표시는 개인정보의 별도 스위치에서 설정해요.

column1: Hide the search pill on reels
Hides the search suggestion under a reel's caption, the magnifier with a question to look up, the one at the top of its comments and the search bar over reels you open from a profile.
column2: 릴스 캡션 아래의 검색 추천(돋보기와 검색할 질문), 댓글 상단의 검색 추천, 프로필에서 연 릴스 위의 검색창을 숨겨요.

column1: Hide the top right buttons on opened videos
column2: 연 동영상의 오른쪽 위 버튼 숨기기

column1: Takes Search and the button next to it off the top of a video or reel you open, and off the Reels tab. Back and Menu stay, and so does More at the bottom of the side buttons, where Download is.
column2: 연 동영상이나 릴스 상단과 릴스 탭에서 검색 버튼과 그 옆 버튼을 없애요. 뒤로와 메뉴는 그대로 남고, 다운로드가 있는 옆쪽 버튼 맨 아래의 더보기도 남아요.

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance; the button is Facebook's Messenger icon in the top bar of Home
Hide the Messenger button
# context: summary of that switch; the other top bar buttons move over to fill the space; Hushfacebook is the app's name
Takes the Messenger button out of the top bar, and the buttons beside it close up the gap. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 상단 바에서 메신저 버튼을 없애고, 옆 버튼들이 빈자리를 채워요. 변경 사항을 보려면 Facebook을 다시 시작하세요.

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance; the count is the unread number badge on the Messenger icon
Hide the Messenger count
# context: summary of that switch; the Messenger icon stays in the top bar
Keeps the Messenger button but drops the unread count on it.
column2: 메신저 버튼은 그대로 두고 읽지 않은 메시지 수만 없애요.

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance; the logo is the Facebook wordmark or icon at the left of the top bar
Hide the Facebook logo
# context: summary of that switch; Hushfacebook is the app's name and stays as it is; press and hold is a long press
Hides the Facebook logo in the top bar. The empty spot is the same size and still opens Hushfacebook settings when you press and hold it. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 상단 바의 Facebook 로고를 숨겨요. 빈자리는 크기가 그대로이며 길게 누르면 여전히 Hushfacebook 설정이 열려요. 변경 사항을 보려면 Facebook을 다시 시작하세요.

column1: Hide the Create button
Takes the + button for making a post, reel or story out of the top bar. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 상단 바에서 게시물, 릴스, 스토리를 만드는 + 버튼을 없애요. 변경 사항을 보려면 Facebook을 다시 시작하세요.

column1: Hide the search button
Takes the search button out of the top bar. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 상단 바에서 검색 버튼을 없애요. 변경 사항을 보려면 Facebook을 다시 시작하세요.

column1: Search with a picture

Press and hold the search button to open Google Lens, then point the camera at something or pick a picture to find out what it is. The picture goes to Google, not Facebook. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 검색 버튼을 길게 눌러 Google 렌즈를 연 다음, 카메라로 무언가를 비추거나 사진을 골라 무엇인지 알아보세요. 사진은 Facebook이 아닌 Google로 전송돼요. 변경 사항을 보려면 Facebook을 다시 시작하세요.

column1: No app on this phone can open Google Lens
column2: 이 휴대폰에 Google 렌즈를 열 수 있는 앱이 없음

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; the counts are the numbers on the Like, Comment and Share buttons under a post
Hide counts on posts
# context: summary of that switch; Like, Comment and Share are Facebook's own button labels, so use Facebook's wording in your language
Takes the numbers off the Like, Comment and Share buttons under posts, so each shows just its word. The buttons stay where they are. A change shows on the posts drawn after it.
column2: 게시물 아래의 좋아요, 댓글 달기, 공유하기 버튼에서 숫자를 없애고 버튼 이름만 표시해요. 버튼 위치는 그대로예요. 변경 사항은 이후에 표시되는 게시물부터 적용돼요.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; the counts are the numbers under the Like, Comment and Share icons down a reel's right side
Hide counts on reels
# context: summary of that switch; Like, Comment and Share are Facebook's own button labels, so use Facebook's wording in your language
Takes the numbers away from under a reel's Like, Comment and Share icons. The icons stay where they are. A change shows from the next reel.
column2: 릴스의 좋아요, 댓글 달기, 공유하기 아이콘 아래 숫자를 없애요. 아이콘 위치는 그대로예요. 변경 사항은 다음 릴스부터 적용돼요.

column1: # context: Reels and Watch switch for the dedicated WhatsApp sidebar button, independent of the Share menu
Hide WhatsApp on reels
Hides the WhatsApp button beside reels and videos. WhatsApp stays in the Share menu. A change shows from the next video.
column2: 릴스와 동영상 옆의 WhatsApp 버튼을 숨겨요. 공유 메뉴의 WhatsApp은 그대로 남아요. 변경 사항은 다음 동영상부터 적용돼요.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; Like is Facebook's own label for that button down a reel's right side, so use Facebook's wording in your language
Hide Like on reels
# context: switch title under Reels and Watch; Comment is Facebook's own label for that button down a reel's right side, so use Facebook's wording in your language
Hide Comment on reels
# context: switch title under Reels and Watch; Repost is Facebook's own label for the two-arrows button down a reel's right side, so use Facebook's wording in your language
Hide Repost on reels
# context: switch title under Reels and Watch; Share is Facebook's own label for that button down a reel's right side, so use Facebook's wording in your language
Hide Share on reels
# context: summary shared by the Like, Comment, Repost and Share switches on reels
Takes this button off the side of reels. The buttons above it move down. A change shows from the next reel.
column2: 릴스 옆쪽에서 이 버튼을 없애요. 위에 있던 버튼이 아래로 내려와요. 변경 사항은 다음 릴스부터 적용돼요.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; Save is Facebook's own label for the bookmark button down a reel's right side, so use Facebook's wording in your language
Hide Save on reels
# context: summary of that switch; the buttons under it are Download and More
Takes the Save button off the side of reels. The buttons above it move down. A change shows from the next reel.
column2: 릴스 옆쪽에서 저장 버튼을 없애요. 위에 있던 버튼이 아래로 내려와요. 변경 사항은 다음 릴스부터 적용돼요.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; the speaker is the sound on and off button at the bottom of the row of buttons down a reel's right side
Hide the speaker button on reels
# context: summary of that switch
Takes the speaker button off the bottom of the side of reels. A change shows from the next reel.
column2: 릴스 옆쪽 맨 아래의 스피커 버튼을 없애요. 변경 사항은 다음 릴스부터 적용돼요.

column1: Move the speaker above the three dots
Puts the speaker button in the side column of reels, right above the three dots. A change shows from the next reel.
column2: 스피커 버튼을 릴스 옆쪽 버튼 열의 점 3개 바로 위에 놓아요. 변경 사항은 다음 릴스부터 적용돼요.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; the reaction preview is the stack of reaction icons and the line with the number of reactions under a post
Hide the reaction preview on posts
# context: summary of that switch; "reactions" are Facebook's Like, Love, Haha and other reactions

Hides the stacked reaction icons and the reactions count under posts. The space stays, so a tap where they were still opens the list of reactions. To take the number off the Like button too, turn on Hide counts on posts.
column2: 게시물 아래에 겹쳐 표시되는 감정 표현 아이콘과 감정 표현 수를 숨겨요. 공간은 그대로 남아서 그 자리를 탭하면 여전히 감정 표현 목록이 열려요. 좋아요 버튼의 숫자도 없애려면 "게시물의 숫자 숨기기"를 켜세요.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; the reactions are the small stacked reaction icons (Like, Love, Haha) a post shows next to its count; the Like button is the button under a post, use Facebook's name for it
Show reactions on the Like button
# context: summary of that switch; the faces are those reaction icons; "Hide the reaction preview on posts" is another switch, match its own row

Moves a post's reaction faces from the end of its button row onto the Like button, right before the count. The Like button likes and reacts as before. A video showing its views there gets one Like face, or your own reaction once you react. Hide the reaction preview on posts overrules it. A change shows on the posts drawn after it.
column2: 게시물 버튼 줄 끝에 있는 감정 표현 아이콘을 좋아요 버튼의 숫자 바로 앞으로 옮겨요. 좋아요 버튼은 이전처럼 좋아요와 감정 표현을 남겨요. 그 자리에 조회수를 표시하는 동영상에는 좋아요 아이콘 하나가 표시되고, 감정 표현을 남기면 내 감정 표현이 표시돼요. "게시물의 감정 표현 미리보기 숨기기"가 우선해요. 변경 사항은 이후에 표시되는 게시물부터 적용돼요.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; the reaction preview is the stack of reaction icons in the corner of a comment
Hide the reaction preview on comments
Hide reaction counts on comments
# context: summary of that switch; "reactions" are Facebook's Like, Love, Haha and other reactions
Hides the stacked reaction icons in the corner of a comment. The space stays, so a tap where they were still opens the list of reactions.
column2: 댓글 모서리에 겹쳐 표시되는 감정 표현 아이콘을 숨겨요. 공간은 그대로 남아서 그 자리를 탭하면 여전히 감정 표현 목록이 열려요.

column1: Hides the number next to the reaction icons on a comment. The icons stay, and a tap on them still opens the list of reactions.
column2: 댓글의 감정 표현 아이콘 옆 숫자를 숨겨요. 아이콘은 그대로 남고, 탭하면 여전히 감정 표현 목록이 열려요.

column1: # context: switch title under Downloads; "Download" is the post menu row "Download to phone" and "post menus" are the three-dot menus under posts
Download first in post menus
# context: summary of that switch; "Download to phone" and "Save photo" are the menu rows, translate them as elsewhere; "More options" is the title of Facebook's own page, use Facebook's wording

Moves Download to phone and Save photo from the end of a post's three-dot menu to the start of its options list. Facebook's own top rows stay above them (on photo posts the list is the More options page). A post with nothing to save gets neither.
column2: 게시물 점 3개 메뉴 끝에 있는 "휴대폰에 다운로드"와 "사진 저장"을 옵션 목록 맨 앞으로 옮겨요. Facebook 자체 상단 항목은 그 위에 남아요(사진 게시물에서는 "옵션 더 보기" 페이지가 목록이에요). 저장할 것이 없는 게시물에는 둘 다 표시되지 않아요.

column1: # context: row title under Menu; opens a list of the Menu's tiles to hide, such as Marketplace and Gaming
Menu tiles to hide
# context: title of the list of Menu tiles to hide
Hide from the Menu
# context: a row's name in the list of Menu tiles to hide; "Help and support" is Facebook's own Menu heading, use Facebook's wording; %s is the row's name, such as Report a problem
Help and support: %s
# context: a row's name in the list of Menu tiles to hide; "Settings and privacy" is Facebook's own Menu heading, use Facebook's wording; %s is the row's name, such as Orders and payments
Settings and privacy: %s
# context: a Menu tile's name in the list of tiles to hide; Facebook's own name for it; Facebook's short videos
Reels
# context: a Menu tile's name in the list of tiles to hide; Facebook's own name for it; the games section
Gaming
# context: a Menu tile's name in the list of tiles to hide; Facebook's own name for it; the look-back posts from past years
Memories
# context: a Menu tile's name in the list of tiles to hide; Facebook's own name for it; the friends' birthdays page
Birthdays
# context: a Menu tile's name in the list of tiles to hide; Facebook's own name for it; the charity fundraisers page
Fundraisers
# context: a Menu tile's name in the list of tiles to hide; Facebook's own name for it; job listings
Jobs
# context: a Menu tile's name in the list of tiles to hide; Facebook's own name for it; the Finds shopping tab, a product name Facebook keeps in English
Finds
# context: a Menu tile's name in the list of tiles to hide; Facebook's own name for it; Facebook's dating feature
Dating
# context: import preview and toast, no Menu tile will be in that list after the import
Your list of Menu tiles to hide will be empty.
column2: 숨길 메뉴 타일 목록이 비게 돼요.

column1: # context: import preview and toast, one Menu tile will be in that list after the import
Your list of Menu tiles to hide will hold %1$d tile.
column2: 숨길 메뉴 타일 목록에 타일 %1$d개가 들어가요.

column1: # context: import preview and toast, several Menu tiles will be in that list after the import
Your list of Menu tiles to hide will hold %1$d tiles.
column2: 숨길 메뉴 타일 목록에 타일 %1$d개가 들어가요.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; on, a double tap on a reel opens its comments
Double tap opens comments
# context: switch title under Reels and Watch; on, holding a reel opens its comments
Long press opens comments
# context: summary of the double tap switch
A double tap on a reel opens its comments instead of liking it. Turn off double tap to like still wins when it's on. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: 릴스를 두 번 탭하면 좋아요 대신 댓글이 열려요. "두 번 탭하여 좋아요 표시 비활성화"가 켜져 있으면 그 설정이 우선해요. 아직 실제 계정에서 테스트하지 않아서 기본적으로 꺼져 있어요.

column1: # context: summary of the long press switch

Holding a reel opens its comments instead of Facebook's long-press menu or the 2x hold. The reel's more button still opens that menu. Holding a feed post's photo or the line with its name opens that post's comments, and holding its text or a profile picture works as before. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: 릴스를 길게 누르면 Facebook의 길게 누르기 메뉴나 2배속 대신 댓글이 열려요. 릴스의 더보기 버튼으로는 여전히 그 메뉴를 열 수 있어요. 피드 게시물의 사진이나 이름이 있는 줄을 길게 누르면 그 게시물의 댓글이 열리고, 텍스트나 프로필 사진을 길게 누르면 이전처럼 작동해요. 아직 실제 계정에서 테스트하지 않아서 기본적으로 꺼져 있어요.

column1: # context: switch title under Downloads; the switch adds the post menu row "Open in another app" to feed and Watch videos
Open videos in another app
# context: summary of that switch; "Open in another app" is the menu row; VLC and Web Video Caster are app names, keep them
Adds Open in another app to feed and Watch video menus. It hands the video to a player or casting app, such as VLC or Web Video Caster. A video with no single file to hand over says so.
column2: 피드와 Watch 동영상 메뉴에 "다른 앱에서 열기"를 추가해요. VLC나 Web Video Caster 같은 플레이어나 캐스팅 앱으로 동영상을 넘겨요. 넘길 단일 파일이 없는 동영상은 그렇다고 알려 줘요.

column1: # context: post menu row that hands the video to a player or casting app, next to the row "Download to phone"
Open in another app
# context: title of Android's app chooser, shown over the apps that can play a video
Open the video with
# context: toast when the video has no single file to hand to another app
Couldn't find a file for this video. Play it for a moment, then try again.
column2: 이 동영상의 파일을 찾지 못했어요. 잠시 재생한 다음 다시 시도하세요.

column1: # context: toast when Android has no app that plays a video file
No app on this phone can open this video
column2: 이 휴대폰에 이 동영상을 열 수 있는 앱이 없음

column1: New
# context: label of the switch that keeps a list of the reels, videos and stories you watched
Remember what you watch
# context: summary of the Remember what you watch switch
Keeps a list on this phone of the reels, videos and stories you watch, so you can find one again after the feed refreshes. Nothing leaves your phone.
column2: 시청한 릴스, 동영상, 스토리 목록을 이 휴대폰에 보관해서 피드를 새로고침한 후에도 다시 찾을 수 있어요. 어떤 데이터도 휴대폰 밖으로 나가지 않아요.

column1: # context: title of the row and the list of the reels, videos and stories you watched, newest first; not Facebook's own Watch history
Recently watched
# context: summary of the Recently watched row
Reels, videos and stories you watched, newest first. Tap one to open it again.
column2: 시청한 릴스, 동영상, 스토리를 최신순으로 보여 줘요. 다시 열려면 탭하세요.

column1: # context: chip in the Recently watched list that shows only videos
Videos
# context: kind of one entry in the Recently watched list: a reel
Reel
# context: kind of one entry in the Recently watched list: a story
Story
# context: button that empties the Recently watched list at once
Clear
Just now
# context: toast after Clear empties the Recently watched list
List cleared
# context: shown in the Recently watched list while it's empty; names the Remember what you watch switch
Nothing here yet. With Remember what you watch on, the reels, videos and stories you watch show up here.
column2: 아직 항목이 없어요. "시청한 항목 기억"이 켜져 있으면 시청한 릴스, 동영상, 스토리가 여기에 표시돼요.

column1: # context: shown in the Recently watched list when the picked chip has no entries
Nothing of this kind yet.
# context: summary of the Full height choice; Comment is the button under a reel or video, the split view shows the video above the comments
Comments open on a sheet that fills the screen instead of stopping part way up. On reels and videos, Comment opens that sheet in place of the split view with the video on top.
column2: 댓글이 중간까지만 올라오지 않고 화면을 가득 채우는 시트로 열려요. 릴스와 동영상에서는 댓글 달기를 누르면 동영상이 위에 있는 분할 화면 대신 이 시트가 열려요.

column1: # context: title of the list that picks how high the comments sheet opens; its choices follow
Open comments at
Facebook's height
Full height
Half height
# context: summary of the Half height choice; Comment is the button under a reel or video
Comments open on a sheet that covers half the screen, and the reel or video keeps playing above it. On reels and videos, Comment opens that sheet in place of the split view.
column2: 댓글이 화면 절반을 덮는 시트로 열리고, 그 위에서 릴스나 동영상이 계속 재생돼요. 릴스와 동영상에서는 댓글 달기를 누르면 분할 화면 대신 이 시트가 열려요.

column1: Comments open where Facebook stops them, part way up on reels and videos.
column2: 댓글이 Facebook 기본 높이로 열려요. 릴스와 동영상에서는 중간까지 올라와요.

column1: # context: sentences in a settings import preview
Comments will open at full height.
Comments will open at half height.
Comments will open where Facebook stops them.
# context: switch title under Appearance; on, Android's status bar (clock, battery) is hidden on Facebook's main screen
Hide the status bar
# context: summary of that switch; a swipe down from the top edge shows the bar briefly
Takes the phone's status bar, with the time and battery, off Facebook's main screen, so the app gets the whole screen. Swipe down from the top edge to see it for a moment.
column2: Facebook 기본 화면에서 시간과 배터리가 표시되는 휴대폰 상태 표시줄을 없애서 앱이 화면 전체를 써요. 잠시 보려면 화면 위쪽 끝에서 아래로 스와이프하세요.

column1: Center the feed on big screens
On a tablet or an unfolded phone, the feed and Facebook's other lists stay in a column down the middle of the screen instead of stretching from edge to edge. Reels keep the whole screen.
column2: 태블릿이나 펼친 폴더블 휴대폰에서 피드와 Facebook의 다른 목록이 화면 양 끝까지 늘어나지 않고 가운데 한 열로 표시돼요. 릴스는 화면 전체를 그대로 사용해요.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; on, a video tapped in the news feed opens alone in the full-screen player instead of leading into endless reels
Open feed videos on their own
# context: summary of that switch; the Reels tab itself still scrolls normally
A video you tap in the feed opens full screen by itself, with no reels to swipe to after it. The Reels tab keeps scrolling. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: 피드에서 탭한 동영상이 전체 화면으로 단독으로 열리고, 이후에 넘겨 볼 릴스가 없어요. 릴스 탭은 계속 스크롤돼요. 아직 실제 계정에서 테스트하지 않아서 기본적으로 꺼져 있어요.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; on, tapping Watch again when a video in the news feed ends plays it again in the feed instead of opening it in the Reels viewer
Replay feed videos in place
# context: summary of that switch; Watch again is Facebook's own button shown when a feed video ends, so use Facebook's wording in your language if you know it
Watch again at the end of a feed video plays it again right there, instead of opening it in Reels.
column2: 피드 동영상이 끝날 때 "다시 보기"를 누르면 릴스에서 열리지 않고 그 자리에서 다시 재생돼요.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; on, a video tapped in Facebook's Saved list plays in the regular video player instead of the Reels viewer
Open saved videos in the video player
# context: summary of that switch; Saved is Facebook's own list of things you saved, so use Facebook's name for it in your language if you know it
A video you tap in Saved plays in the video player instead of Reels, where the next swipe is a suggested reel.
column2: 저장됨에서 탭한 동영상이 다음에 넘기면 추천 릴스가 나오는 릴스 대신 동영상 플레이어에서 재생돼요.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; on, a reel opened from Facebook's Saved list goes on to the next saved video when it ends or is swiped past, instead of Facebook's suggested reels
Play saved videos in a row
# context: summary of that switch; Saved is Facebook's own list of things you saved, so use Facebook's name for it in your language if you know it
A video you open from Saved goes on to the next one in Saved when it ends or when you swipe up, instead of a suggested reel. Swipe down to go back one.
column2: 저장됨에서 연 동영상이 끝나거나 위로 스와이프하면 추천 릴스 대신 저장됨의 다음 동영상으로 넘어가요. 이전 동영상으로 돌아가려면 아래로 스와이프하세요.

column1: # context: switch title under Play saved videos in a row; on, a saved video that ends stays where it is instead of moving on to the next saved one
Stay on a saved video when it ends
# context: summary of that switch
A saved video that ends stays on screen instead of opening the next one. Swipe up when you want the next.
column2: 저장한 동영상이 끝나도 다음 동영상을 열지 않고 화면에 남아 있어요. 다음 동영상을 보려면 위로 스와이프하세요.

column1: # context: switch title under Play saved videos in a row; on, a saved post the row reaches stays on screen instead of being skipped, and a swipe past its end moves on
Show saved posts in the row
# context: summary of that switch
A saved post in the row stays on screen instead of being skipped. Swipe up past its end for the next saved video, or down past its top for the one before.
column2: 연속 재생 중 저장한 게시물이 건너뛰어지지 않고 화면에 표시돼요. 다음 저장한 동영상을 보려면 게시물 끝을 지나 위로, 이전 동영상을 보려면 게시물 맨 위를 지나 아래로 스와이프하세요.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; on, Facebook stops pausing reels and videos to ask "Are you still watching?", which is Facebook's own prompt, so use the wording Facebook shows in this language
Skip "Are you still watching?"
# context: summary of that switch; reels and videos go on to the next one by themselves
Reels and videos keep going to the next one without pausing to ask if you're still watching.
column2: 릴스와 동영상이 아직 시청 중인지 묻느라 멈추지 않고 다음 항목으로 계속 넘어가요.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; on, a reel that would show black bars above and below (or at the sides) is enlarged until it fills the whole screen
Fill the screen with reels
# context: summary of that switch; the reel is zoomed in until it reaches every edge, so a little of the picture at two of its edges is cut off
Reels and full-screen videos that would leave black bars fill the screen instead, with a little cut off the edges. Pinch in on a reel to see all of it, or pinch out to fill it again.
column2: 검은 여백이 생기는 릴스와 전체 화면 동영상이 가장자리가 조금 잘리는 대신 화면을 가득 채워요. 릴스 전체를 보려면 두 손가락을 오므리고, 다시 채우려면 벌리세요.

column1: Hide the new comments pop-up
# context: the bubble Facebook shows over an open comment list when new comments arrive, like "3 new comments"
The "new comments" bubble no longer pops up while you read comments. New comments still show in the list.
column2: 댓글을 읽는 동안 "새 댓글" 말풍선이 더 이상 나타나지 않아요. 새 댓글은 목록에 그대로 표시돼요.

column1: # context: the name of a launcher shortcut and a Menu row that open Marketplace's free listings (Facebook's website calls that category Free Stuff)
Free stuff
Free stuff shortcut
Free stuff isn't available in this build.
column2: 이 빌드에서는 무료 나눔을 사용할 수 없어요.

column1: Adds Free stuff, Marketplace's free listings, to the menu you get by holding Facebook's icon, if there's room, and a Free stuff row in Settings and privacy. Existing shortcuts stay.
column2: 공간이 있으면 Facebook 아이콘을 길게 눌렀을 때 나오는 메뉴에 마켓플레이스의 무료 판매글인 무료 나눔을 추가하고, 설정 및 개인정보에 무료 나눔 항목도 추가해요. 기존 바로가기는 그대로 남아요.

column1: Adds Free stuff, Marketplace's free listings, to the menu you get by holding Facebook's icon, if there's room. Existing shortcuts stay.
column2: 공간이 있으면 Facebook 아이콘을 길게 눌렀을 때 나오는 메뉴에 마켓플레이스의 무료 판매글인 무료 나눔을 추가해요. 기존 바로가기는 그대로 남아요.

column1: # context: row in a video's menu while Skip silent parts is on; the video's silent parts are skipped
Skip silent parts: on
# context: the same row after a tap; this one video keeps its silent parts
Skip silent parts: off for this video
column2: 무음 구간 건너뛰기: 이 동영상에서는 꺼짐

column1: # context: short message after tapping the row; this video now plays its silent parts
Silent parts play in this video
# context: short message after tapping the row again; silent parts are skipped again
Skipping silent parts again
# context: switch title under News feed; posts Facebook shows from groups the user hasn't joined, which come with a Join button next to the group's name
Hide posts from groups you're not in
# context: summary of that switch; a group post a friend commented on or shared reaches the feed wrapped in the friend's activity, and the switch hides it too
Hides posts from groups you haven't joined, like a friend's post in a public group, and a group post a friend commented on or shared. Posts from your groups stay.
column2: 공개 그룹에 올라온 친구의 게시물처럼 가입하지 않은 그룹의 게시물과, 친구가 댓글을 달거나 공유한 그룹 게시물을 숨겨요. 가입한 그룹의 게시물은 그대로 남아요.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; hides every post that comes from a group, including groups the user is a member of
Hide all group posts
# context: summary of that switch; the Groups tab is Facebook's own tab of group posts, which this switch leaves alone
Hides every post from a group in your feed, your own groups' too, and a group post a friend commented on or shared. The Groups tab keeps its feed.
column2: 가입한 그룹을 포함해 피드의 모든 그룹 게시물과, 친구가 댓글을 달거나 공유한 그룹 게시물을 숨겨요. 그룹 탭의 피드는 그대로 유지돼요.

column1: # context: switch title under Search; For you is the section of searches Facebook suggests on the search screen before anything is typed, under a header that reads For you
Hide For you in search
# context: summary of that switch; recent searches are the user's own past searches, and the suggestions as you type are the ones under the search box while typing
Hides the For you searches Facebook suggests when you open search. Your recent searches and the suggestions as you type stay.
column2: 검색을 열 때 Facebook이 제안하는 "회원님을 위한 추천" 검색어를 숨겨요. 최근 검색과 입력 중 표시되는 추천은 그대로 남아요.

column1: # context: switch title under Search; People you may know is Facebook's row of friend suggestions on the search screen before anything is typed, as in Hide "People you may know"
Hide "People you may know" in search
# context: summary of that switch; recent searches are the user's own past searches, and the suggestions as you type are the ones under the search box while typing
Hides the People you may know row Facebook shows when you open search. Your recent searches and the suggestions as you type stay.
column2: 검색을 열 때 Facebook이 표시하는 "알 수도 있는 사람" 줄을 숨겨요. 최근 검색과 입력 중 표시되는 추천은 그대로 남아요.

column1: # context: switch title under Search; on, what the user searches for isn't added to their Facebook search history
Don't save search history
# context: summary of that switch; searches already in the history are the user's own past searches, which stay until the user deletes them
What you search for, and the pages and profiles you open from a search, aren't added to your Facebook search history. Searches already there stay until you delete them.
column2: 검색한 내용과 검색에서 연 페이지 및 프로필이 Facebook 검색 기록에 추가되지 않아요. 이미 있는 검색 기록은 삭제할 때까지 남아 있어요.

column1: # context: switch title under Search; on, the Date posted filter in post search asks for a from and to month instead of a list of years; Date posted is Facebook's own filter name in search results
Search date range
# context: summary of that switch; Date posted is Facebook's own filter name in post search results, named here as Facebook shows it
The Date posted filter in post search asks for a from and to date, in place of a list of years.
column2: 게시물 검색의 "게시 날짜" 필터에서 연도 목록 대신 시작 날짜와 종료 날짜를 입력해요.

column1: From day
To day
# context: switch title under Reels and Watch; the audio line is the scrolling line at the bottom of a reel naming its sound, like "Name · Original audio" or a song title
Hide the audio line on reels
# context: summary of that switch; "Original audio" is Facebook's own label, so use the wording Facebook shows in this language
Takes the line with the reel's sound, "Original audio" or a song, off the bottom of reels. Other info stays. A change shows from the next reel.
column2: 릴스 하단에서 "원본 오디오"나 노래 같은 릴스 소리 정보 줄을 없애요. 다른 정보는 그대로 남아요. 변경 사항은 다음 릴스부터 적용돼요.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; the message is Facebook's own "This is taking a while. Try checking your network connection." that pops up while a video or GIF loads slowly
Hide the slow connection message
# context: summary of that switch; "This is taking a while" is Facebook's own message, so use the wording Facebook shows in this language
Stops the "This is taking a while" message about your network connection when a video or GIF is slow to load. It keeps loading as before.
column2: 동영상이나 GIF를 느리게 불러올 때 네트워크 연결에 대한 "시간이 좀 걸리고 있습니다" 메시지를 표시하지 않아요. 불러오기는 이전처럼 계속돼요.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; the Reels row is the strip of reel tiles Facebook shows between posts in the news feed, each tile playing a short clip of its reel over and over
Play whole reels in the feed's Reels row
column2: 피드 릴스 줄에서 릴스 전체 재생

column1: # context: summary of that switch; a tile is one reel's box in that row
The reels in your feed's Reels row play from the start and keep going, instead of repeating a second or two. Tiles drawn after a change pick it up.
column2: 피드 릴스 줄의 릴스가 1~2초만 반복하지 않고 처음부터 계속 재생돼요. 변경 후 표시되는 타일부터 적용돼요.

column1: # context: title of the row on the Appearance page, with AMOLED in the build, that takes a color code for dark mode's backgrounds; also its dialog's title
Background color
# context: text in that row's dialog above the field; %1$s is the lightest gray code it takes, %2$s the color code the patch wrote, both like #0D1117; keep #RRGGBB and #0D1117 as they are
A color code (#RRGGBB) for dark mode's backgrounds, like #0D1117. Grays up to about %1$s work. Leave it blank for %2$s, the color Hushfacebook was patched with.
column2: 다크 모드 배경에 사용할 색상 코드(#RRGGBB)예요(예: #0D1117). 약 %1$s까지의 회색을 사용할 수 있어요. 비워 두면 Hushfacebook을 패치할 때 지정한 색(%2$s)을 사용해요.

column1: # context: summary of that row while it's blank; %1$s is the color code the patch wrote, like #0D1117
Uses %1$s, the color Hushfacebook was patched with. Type a color code to change it.
column2: Hushfacebook을 패치할 때 지정한 색(%1$s)을 사용해요. 바꾸려면 색상 코드를 입력하세요.

column1: # context: summary of that row with a color saved; %1$s is that color code, like #0D1117
Dark mode's backgrounds use %1$s. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 다크 모드 배경에 %1$s 색을 사용해요. 변경 사항을 보려면 Facebook을 다시 시작하세요.

column1: # context: shown when Save is tapped on that row with text that isn't a color code; %1$s is what was typed; keep #RRGGBB and #0D1117 as they are
%1$s isn't a color. Type a six-digit color code (#RRGGBB), like #0D1117, or leave it blank for the color Hushfacebook was patched with.
column2: %1$s 값은 색상이 아니에요. #0D1117처럼 6자리 색상 코드(#RRGGBB)를 입력하거나, Hushfacebook을 패치할 때 지정한 색을 쓰려면 비워 두세요.

column1: # context: shown when Save is tapped on that row with an eight-digit code that isn't fully opaque; %1$s is what was typed; keep #RRGGBB and #0D1117 as they are
%1$s is see-through. Type a solid six-digit color code (#RRGGBB), like #0D1117.
column2: %1$s 색은 투명해요. #0D1117처럼 불투명한 6자리 색상 코드(#RRGGBB)를 입력하세요.

column1: # context: shown when Save is tapped on that row with a color too light for Facebook's white text; %1$s is what was typed, %2$s the lightest gray code it takes
%1$s is too light for Facebook's text to stay readable. Pick a darker color. Grays up to about %2$s work.
column2: %1$s 색은 너무 밝아서 Facebook 텍스트가 잘 보이지 않아요. 더 어두운 색을 고르세요. 약 %2$s까지의 회색을 사용할 수 있어요.

column1: # context: import preview sentence: the file sets AMOLED's Background color row back to blank; "AMOLED black theme" is the patch's name, keep it as translated for that patch
If your patched Facebook includes the AMOLED black theme, dark mode's backgrounds will be the color it was patched with.
column2: 패치된 Facebook에 AMOLED 블랙 테마가 포함되어 있으면 다크 모드 배경이 패치할 때 지정한 색으로 설정돼요.

column1: # context: import preview sentence: the file sets AMOLED's Background color row; %1$s is a color code like #0D1117; "AMOLED black theme" is the patch's name, keep it as translated for that patch
If your patched Facebook includes the AMOLED black theme, dark mode's backgrounds will be %1$s.
column2: 패치된 Facebook에 AMOLED 블랙 테마가 포함되어 있으면 다크 모드 배경이 %1$s 색으로 설정돼요.

column1: # context: title of the row on the Appearance page, with AMOLED in the build, that takes a color code for light mode's backgrounds in place of white; also its dialog's title
Light background color
# context: message in that row's dialog; %1$s is a gray color code like #A6A6A6; keep #RRGGBB and #FFF8E7 as they are
A color code (#RRGGBB) for light mode's backgrounds in place of white, like #FFF8E7. Grays down to about %1$s work, and text gets darker where it needs to. Leave it blank for Facebook's own white.
column2: 라이트 모드에서 흰색 대신 사용할 배경 색상 코드(#RRGGBB)예요(예: #FFF8E7). 약 %1$s까지의 회색을 사용할 수 있으며, 필요한 곳은 텍스트가 더 어두워져요. Facebook 기본 흰색을 쓰려면 비워 두세요.

column1: # context: summary of that row while it's blank, so Facebook's light mode keeps its own white backgrounds
Uses Facebook's own white. Type a color code to change it.
column2: Facebook 기본 흰색을 사용해요. 바꾸려면 색상 코드를 입력하세요.

column1: # context: summary of that row once a color is saved; %1$s is the color code
Light mode's backgrounds use %1$s. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 라이트 모드 배경에 %1$s 색을 사용해요. 변경 사항을 보려면 Facebook을 다시 시작하세요.

column1: # context: shown when Save is tapped on that row with text that isn't a color code; %1$s is what was typed; keep #RRGGBB and #FFF8E7 as they are
%1$s isn't a color. Type a six-digit color code (#RRGGBB), like #FFF8E7, or leave it blank for Facebook's own white.
column2: %1$s 값은 색상이 아니에요. #FFF8E7처럼 6자리 색상 코드(#RRGGBB)를 입력하거나, Facebook 기본 흰색을 쓰려면 비워 두세요.

column1: # context: shown when Save is tapped on that row with an eight-digit code that isn't fully opaque; %1$s is what was typed; keep #RRGGBB and #FFF8E7 as they are
%1$s is see-through. Type a solid six-digit color code (#RRGGBB), like #FFF8E7.
column2: %1$s 색은 투명해요. #FFF8E7처럼 불투명한 6자리 색상 코드(#RRGGBB)를 입력하세요.

column1: # context: shown when Save is tapped on that row with a color too dark for light mode's dark text; %1$s is what was typed, %2$s a gray color code like #A6A6A6
%1$s is too dark for Facebook's light mode text to stay readable. Pick a lighter color. Grays down to about %2$s work.
column2: %1$s 색은 너무 어두워서 Facebook 라이트 모드 텍스트가 잘 보이지 않아요. 더 밝은 색을 고르세요. 약 %2$s까지의 회색을 사용할 수 있어요.

column1: # context: import preview sentence: the file sets AMOLED's Light background color row back to blank; "AMOLED black theme" is the patch's name, keep it as translated for that patch
If your patched Facebook includes the AMOLED black theme, light mode's backgrounds will be Facebook's own white.

column1: # context: import preview sentence: the file sets AMOLED's Light background color row; %1$s is a color code like #FFF8E7; "AMOLED black theme" is the patch's name, keep it as translated for that patch
If your patched Facebook includes the AMOLED black theme, light mode's backgrounds will be %1$s.
column2: 패치된 Facebook에 AMOLED 블랙 테마가 포함되어 있으면 라이트 모드 배경이 %1$s 색으로 설정돼요.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed, part of Hide suggested and promoted posts; "Related posts" is the heading Facebook shows over a list under a post
Hide "Related posts" under posts
# context: summary of that switch; "Related posts" is that heading, and Meta AI writes the titles in the list
Hides the "Related posts" list Facebook adds under some posts, with its titles written by Meta AI. The post and its comments stay.
column2: Facebook이 일부 게시물 아래에 추가하는, Meta AI가 제목을 쓴 "관련 게시물" 목록을 숨겨요. 게시물과 댓글은 그대로 남아요.

column1: # context: title of the row on the Appearance page that takes your own words for the top of Home in place of Facebook's logo; also its dialog's title and the patch's name; Home is Facebook's home feed tab
Home header text
# context: message in that row's dialog; %1$d is the most characters allowed, 30
Your own words at the top of Home instead of the Facebook logo, up to %1$d characters. They take Facebook's colors in light and dark mode. Leave it blank for Facebook's logo.
column2: 홈 상단에 Facebook 로고 대신 표시할 문구예요. 최대 %1$d자까지 입력할 수 있어요. 라이트 모드와 다크 모드에서 Facebook 색상을 따라요. Facebook 로고를 쓰려면 비워 두세요.

column1: # context: summary of that row while it's blank
Facebook's logo stays at the top of Home. Type your own words to show them there.
column2: 홈 상단에 Facebook 로고가 그대로 표시돼요. 원하는 문구를 표시하려면 입력하세요.

column1: # context: summary of that row; %1$s is the saved words
The top of Home says %1$s. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 홈 상단 문구: %1$s. 변경 사항을 보려면 Facebook을 다시 시작하세요.

column1: # context: import preview sentence: the file sets the Home header text row back to blank
The top of Home will show Facebook's own logo.
# context: import preview sentence: the file sets the Home header text row; %1$s is the saved words; "Home header text" is the patch's name, keep it as translated for that patch
If your patched Facebook includes Home header text, the top of Home will say %1$s.
column2: 패치된 Facebook에 홈 상단 텍스트가 포함되어 있으면 홈 상단에 "%1$s" 문구가 표시돼요.

column1: # context: settings row title: picks a picture of your own for the top of Home; pairs with the Home header text row
Home header picture

Show Reels in gray will take reels from color to gray over %1$s.

column1: Show time in Reels
A small label at the top of Reels shows the minutes you've watched. Time on other tabs doesn't count, and 15 minutes away starts it over.
column2: 릴스 상단의 작은 표시에 시청한 시간(분)을 보여 줘요. 다른 탭에서 보낸 시간은 계산되지 않으며, 15분 동안 자리를 비우면 다시 시작돼요.

column1: # context: a short label on the Reels screen; %1$d is a number of minutes
%1$d min
Hide the tab bar on the Reels tab
The tab bar goes away while the Reels tab is open, and the reel gets the whole screen. The other tabs keep the bar. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 릴스 탭이 열려 있는 동안 탭 바가 사라지고 릴스가 화면 전체를 사용해요. 다른 탭에서는 탭 바가 그대로 있어요. 변경 사항을 보려면 Facebook을 다시 시작하세요.

column1: Hide the line along the tab bar
The thin line Facebook draws along the edge of the tab bar goes away on every tab. Tap a tab to see the change.
column2: Facebook이 탭 바 가장자리에 그리는 얇은 선이 모든 탭에서 사라져요. 변경 사항을 보려면 탭을 탭하세요.

column1: # context: switch title on the tab bar settings page; a group is a Facebook group's page; the tab bar is the row of Home, Reels, Groups... tabs
Keep the tab bar in groups
# context: summary of that switch; "along the bottom" means at the bottom edge of the screen
A group you open keeps the tab bar along the bottom, so a tap takes you straight to another tab. Works while the tab bar is at the bottom. Open a group to see the change.
column2: 그룹을 열어도 하단에 탭 바가 유지되어 한 번 탭으로 다른 탭으로 바로 이동할 수 있어요. 탭 바가 아래쪽에 있을 때 작동해요. 변경 사항을 보려면 그룹을 여세요.

column1: Playback speed in the post menu
A feed or Watch video's 3-dot menu gets Playback speed, from 0.5x to 3x, live videos too. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: 피드나 Watch 동영상의 점 3개 메뉴에 0.5x~3x 재생 속도가 추가되며, 라이브 방송에도 적용돼요. 아직 실제 계정에서 테스트하지 않아서 기본적으로 꺼져 있어요.

column1: Double tap to skip on feed videos
column2: 피드 동영상 두 번 탭하여 건너뛰기

column1: Double tap the right side of a playing feed video to jump ahead 10 seconds, or the left side to go back 10. Keep tapping to go further. Live videos work too when they can be rewound. One tap on a side still opens the video, a moment later than usual. With Tap to play on, it needs Inline feed video controls on too.
column2: 재생 중인 피드 동영상의 오른쪽을 두 번 탭하면 10초 앞으로, 왼쪽을 두 번 탭하면 10초 뒤로 이동해요. 계속 탭하면 더 이동해요. 되감기할 수 있는 라이브 방송에서도 작동해요. 한쪽을 한 번 탭하면 평소보다 조금 늦게 여전히 동영상이 열려요. "탭하여 재생"이 켜져 있으면 "피드 동영상 재생 컨트롤"도 켜야 해요.

column1: # context: switch title under Video playback; a tap on a video in the news feed brings up a pause button in the middle of the video instead of opening it
Tap shows a pause button on feed videos
column2: 피드 동영상 탭하여 일시 정지 버튼 표시

column1: # context: description of that switch; Reels is Facebook's full-screen video viewer, keep the name; the quoted switch names match their own rows

Tapping a feed video shows a pause button in its middle and the video keeps playing, so a tap doesn't open it in Reels. Tap the button to pause or play. Tap the video again while the button shows to open it. Ads keep their own controls. With Tap to play on, it needs Inline feed video controls on too.
column2: 피드 동영상을 탭하면 동영상이 계속 재생되면서 가운데에 일시 정지 버튼이 표시되어, 탭해도 릴스에서 열리지 않아요. 일시 정지하거나 재생하려면 버튼을 탭하세요. 버튼이 표시된 상태에서 동영상을 다시 탭하면 열려요. 광고는 자체 컨트롤을 유지해요. "탭하여 재생"이 켜져 있으면 "피드 동영상 재생 컨트롤"도 켜야 해요.

column1: Show only comments that match
While the search box holds words, comments without them are hidden. Clearing the box brings them back.
column2: 검색창에 단어가 있는 동안 그 단어가 없는 댓글은 숨겨져요. 검색창을 지우면 다시 나타나요.

column1: Queue reel saves

Each reel you tap Download on joins a queue that saves one reel at a time in the background. Pause or cancel it from its notification or from Downloads here. A reel already in the queue is skipped, and one that fails gets one more try. The queue lasts until Facebook closes. Hold Download to save that reel and the ones after it, 10 to 150 at a time.
column2: 다운로드를 탭한 릴스가 대기열에 추가되어 백그라운드에서 한 번에 하나씩 저장돼요. 알림이나 여기의 다운로드에서 일시 정지하거나 취소할 수 있어요. 이미 대기열에 있는 릴스는 건너뛰고, 실패한 릴스는 한 번 더 시도해요. 대기열은 Facebook이 종료될 때까지 유지돼요. 다운로드를 길게 누르면 해당 릴스와 그 뒤의 릴스를 한 번에 10~150개씩 저장해요.

Added to the reel queue. To pause or cancel it, open Downloads in Hushfacebook settings.
column2: 릴스 대기열에 추가했어요. 일시 정지하거나 취소하려면 Hushfacebook 설정에서 다운로드를 여세요.

Highest your screen offers
Facebook runs at whatever refresh rate your phone picks for it.
Facebook asks for your screen's highest refresh rate, so scrolling and reels look smoother. It uses a bit more battery, and your phone's own refresh rate setting still caps it.
column2: Facebook이 화면의 최고 주사율을 요청해서 스크롤과 릴스가 더 부드러워 보여요. 배터리를 조금 더 쓰며, 휴대폰 자체 주사율 설정이 여전히 상한이에요.

Turns every switch and choice that Export settings saves back to how a new install has them. Pause, Debug logging and the update check stay as they are.

column1: Undo the reset
Brings back the switches and choices you had before the last reset.
column2: 마지막 초기화 전에 사용하던 스위치와 선택 항목을 되돌려요.

column1: Your settings already match a new install.
column2: 설정이 이미 새로 설치한 상태와 같아요.

column1: Resetting settings
Settings reset. Undo the reset puts yours back.
column2: 설정을 초기화했어요. "초기화 실행 취소"로 이전 설정을 되돌릴 수 있어요.

column1: Couldn't undo the reset. Nothing was changed.

column1: Show every reaction on comments
Where Facebook shows only a comment's top reaction next to its count, keeps Like, Reply and every reaction instead. A change shows on the comments drawn after it.
column2: Facebook이 댓글 수 옆에 가장 많은 감정 표현만 표시하는 곳에서 좋아요, 답글 달기, 모든 감정 표현을 대신 유지해요. 변경 사항은 이후에 표시되는 댓글부터 적용돼요.

column1: Move seen stories to the end
Stories you've already watched move to the end of the Stories tray, after the ones you haven't. Hide seen stories goes first while it's on. Applies when Facebook next loads the tray.
column2: 이미 본 스토리가 스토리 영역에서 보지 않은 스토리 뒤로 이동해요. "본 스토리 숨기기"가 켜져 있으면 그 설정이 먼저 적용돼요. Facebook이 다음에 스토리 영역을 불러올 때 적용돼요.

column1: Skip location prompts
Facebook's page asking you to allow Location Services, the one with Skip and Continue, doesn't show. Location you turn on yourself still works.
column2: 건너뛰기와 계속 버튼이 있는, 위치 서비스를 허용하라는 Facebook 페이지가 표시되지 않아요. 직접 켠 위치는 계속 작동해요.

Ask before reacting to a story

A tap on a reaction at the bottom of a story asks first, and the story waits. Only Continue sends the reaction.
column2: 스토리 하단의 감정 표현을 탭하면 먼저 확인을 요청하며, 그동안 스토리는 멈춰 있어요. "계속"을 눌러야만 감정 표현이 전송돼요.

column1: # context: the question shown after a tap on a reaction at the bottom of a story; Continue sends the reaction, Cancel leaves it
React to this story?
# context: In-app proxy, an HTTP proxy address (host:port) Facebook's connections go through
In-app proxy

The address and port of an HTTP proxy for Facebook's connections, like %1$s. The local proxy port of a VLESS or V2Ray app such as v2rayNG works here. Leave it blank to connect the way your phone does.
column2: Facebook 연결에 사용할 HTTP 프록시의 주소와 포트예요(예: %1$s). v2rayNG 같은 VLESS 또는 V2Ray 앱의 로컬 프록시 포트도 사용할 수 있어요. 휴대폰과 같은 방식으로 연결하려면 비워 두세요.

column1: Type an HTTP proxy's address and port, like %1$s.
Facebook connects the way your phone does. Type a proxy's address and port to send its connections through it.
column2: Facebook이 휴대폰과 같은 방식으로 연결돼요. 연결을 프록시로 보내려면 프록시 주소와 포트를 입력하세요.

column1: Facebook's connections go through the proxy at %1$s.

column2: 릴스의 다운로드 버튼, 게시물 아래의 다운로드 버튼, 동영상의 "휴대폰에 다운로드"가 먼저 확인을 요청해서 실수로 탭해도 저장되지 않아요. "저장할 때마다 화질 선택"이 켜져 있으면 동영상의 화질 목록이 확인을 대신해요.
